items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Yeah, I play with Papa Suns thing.

ctx.x: So those musicians, they didn't have many more. They didn't. They didn't.

That's all they had to be on the field. That's all they had to be on the field. That's all they had to do to be a musician. That's all. That's all you had to do. That would make me take a license to play music. Play this for your wife. I love that, no, I love that. He said that in front of them. Oh yeah. My wife knows the women love me. I like the women, but I do women's high and chill. You see them on that parade, eh? They be by me, don't they? They be by me. They be by me. They be by me. I be by them too. Well,…

Yeah, I play with Papa Suns thing. Yeah. I play with the band, with Papa Suns thing. Did you get who was in Suns thing then? Did we get that? Well he said most of them. He said all the fellas would work together. Some think of the job he's bad, he's bad, he's bad, he's bad. Yeah.
